title: Privacy, stay, and biometric terms
subtitle: Review how the hotel handles stay rules, document validation, facial verification, and support.

sections.title: 1. Stay rules
body: Guests agree to follow hotel coexistence, safety, quiet hours, and property-use rules during the stay.
Shared areas, amenities, and concierge services may follow specific operating hours and capacity guidance.

sections.title: 2. Document verification
body: For check-in and checkout security, the kiosk may capture a photo of a physical document to read the guest name and document number.
The extracted information is compared with the active reservation for the selected hotel before the flow can continue.

sections.title: 3. Facial biometric validation
body: When enabled, the kiosk compares a live selfie with the face present on the captured document to reduce misuse and protect the reservation holder.
If automated facial comparison is unavailable or inconclusive, the kiosk may use document-only verification and direct the guest to reception when needed.

sections.title: 4. Data handling and retention
body: Images and verification results are used only to complete hotel operational flows, prevent fraud, and support auditability.
Access is restricted to authorized systems and staff, and records should be retained only for the period required by hotel policy or applicable law.

sections.title: 5. Human support
body: Guests may request concierge or reception assistance at any time if the kiosk cannot complete a verification step.
A team member may review the reservation and continue the service manually when automated validation is not enough.
